notes: ACCESS: reached entirely via the Claude-in-Chrome connector, own tab. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (checked live this session). STRUCTURE: read from the URBN monoweb Pinia state (#urbnInitialPiniaState, double JSON-encoded) in the page's own window context - superNav.navItems['shopping-root'] gives the top-level departments; the top-level 'Furniture' item (slug explore-furniture, itemId 98ea9ae8...) is a GATEWAY whose authoritative childSlugs (read from catchAll.breadcrumbs[0].navItem.childSlugs while on a child page) are: outdoor-living-furniture, new-furniture-external, outdoor-sofas-sectionals, all-outdoor-chairs, outdoor-benches, all-outdoor-tables, storage-utility, furniture-collections. Cross-checked per brief Trap #1 against categories_sitemap.xml (fetched same-origin from the loaded page) filtered on furniture/chair/table/sofa/bench/etc keywords - the sitemap surfaced the same 5 real leaf slugs; none of the 8 mega-menu children were sitemap-only surprises this time, but the mega-menu itself only renders 'outdoor-living-furniture' (lazy-loaded hover container was empty in the state), so the sitemap cross-check was what actually confirmed the other 4 leaves exist as real listing pages. All 5 real category pages have empty childSlugs (true leaves, no deeper level) and their own H1/title match the requested slug (checked Magento/Cox&Cox-style silent-parent-serve trap - not present here). EXCLUDED per brief section 3: outdoor-living-furniture ('Shop All Furniture', 205 products) is the roll-up 'Shop All' of the same department now that its real children (Sofas+Sectionals, Chairs, Benches+Ottomans, Tables, Storage+Utility) are known - its own Product Type facet also shows non-furniture noise (Planters 14, Throw Pillows 5, Cleaning Supplies 1) confirming it is a mixed roll-up, not a distinct node; new-furniture-external ('New Furniture', typeCode EXTERNAL) is a New-Arrivals subset, confirmed by title/displayName; furniture-collections is a landingPage-type marketing hub ('Furniture Collection Guide: Meadowbrook, Cabana, Courtyard, Salento'), confirmed via catchAll.pageType='landingPage'. Also checked the separate 'Outdoor Living' top department (slug outdoor-living-collection -> outdoor-living, 'Shop All Outdoor Living | Essentials, Games + Patio Decor', 314 products, childSlugs empty) - this is games/patio-decor/essentials, not furniture, and out of scope; not explored further. COUNTS (Rule 1/2): category.totalRecordCount from the Pinia state is Terrain's structured total; this was independently corroborated on /outdoor-benches by reading the rendered page text, which prints '18 products' matching totalRecordCount=18 exactly (title-count corroboration per rule 4; the prior Home-Decor pass on this same domain already established totalRecordCount==rendered-header equality on 4 other categories, so one fresh spot-check was sufficient rather than re-verifying all 5). Sanity: numbers differ per category (81, 93, 18, 26, 13) - not a site-wide constant; none suspiciously round; Product Type facets on each page corroborate the node's furniture classification (e.g. storage-utility is 13/13 'Storage Furniture' - Console Table, Buffets, Cabinet - matching the brief's storage-furniture INCLUDE list). /outdoor-benches contains one non-furniture stray item ('Tufted Cotton Floor Cushion, Garden Floral', a textile) among its 18 tiles - noted but not excluded since the node's PRIMARY product type is clearly furniture (benches/ottomans/a sofa) per brief section 1's priority rule. No qty is estimated; no nulls; no flags needed. Terrain's Furniture department is entirely outdoor/garden furniture (Terrain sells garden and outdoor lifestyle goods), which is explicitly in scope per brief section 1 (Outdoor/garden/patio furniture INCLUDE).
